facts.statement: Seldsienean was an extinct marine reptile that lived during the Middle Jurassic in England and France.
facts.quote: Seldsienean is an extinct genus of teleosauroid thalattosuchian from the Middle Jurassic of England and France.

facts.statement: Fossilized specimens of Seldsienean have been found in France and England.
facts.quote: Seldsienean es un género extinto de crocodiliforme teleosáurido que vivió desde el Jurásico Medio (Bathoniense). Ejemplares fosilizados han sido hallados en Francia and Inglaterra.

facts.statement: A 2024 study by Mark Young and colleagues classified Seldsienean within the family Teleosauridae, closely related to the subgroup Aeolodontini.
facts.quote: A later study in 2024 by Mark Young and colleagues found Seldsienean to be part of a different teleosauroid group called Teleosauridae. It was found to be most closely related to the subgroup Aeolodontini.

facts.statement: Johnson et al. (2020) argued that the ICZN code invalidated Eudes-Deslongchamps' action because Steneosaurus rostromajor is the type species of Steneosaurus.

facts.statement: Seldsienean possessed long, thin jaws that produced a fast but relatively weak bite, suggesting it was a longirostrine generalist.
facts.quote: Based on its jaw morphology, Seldsienean is thought to have been a longirostrine generalist. It possessed long thin jaws that had a fast but relatively weak bite.
